app_description: AI Song Cover Studio powered by RVC v1/v2

ui.cover_usage: **Quick Start**: 1. Download a character voice or import your own · 2. Choose Full Song or Vocals Only and upload MP3, WAV, or FLAC audio · 3. Pick a voice and click Start Cover. Required models download automatically on first use.
ui.character_choice_info: Shows version tags, character group, and source (epochs = training epochs; 40k / 48k = sample rate).
ui.download_character_info: Shows version tags, character group, and source repository to help distinguish variants.
ui.positive_pitch_info: Positive raises pitch; negative lowers it
ui.reverb_info: Adds room reverb to the converted vocals

conversion.pitch_shift_info: Positive raises pitch; negative lowers it. Match the song to the target voice range.
conversion.f0_method_info: Uses RMVPE to extract singing pitch.
conversion.index_rate_info: Higher values sound closer to the target timbre, though very high values can reduce clarity.
conversion.filter_radius_info: Applies to the local compatibility inference mode.
conversion.rms_mix_rate_info: Higher values follow the output loudness envelope more closely.
conversion.protect_info: Protects consonants and breath sounds; 0.5 disables protection.

cover.fixed_dereverb_info: Built-in Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050 dereverb with floating-point WAV output.
cover.cover_description: Upload a song and pick a character voice to separate, convert, and mix.
cover.automatic_cover_settings_info: Choose an input type, upload audio, and select a voice to start. Open Manual Adjustments below to fine-tune pitch, harmony, or mix.
cover.index_rate_info: Controls how strongly retrieved index features blend in. 0% disables retrieval; disabled when no index is present.
cover.speaker_id_info: Keep 0 for single-speaker models; choose the corresponding ID for multi-speaker models.
cover.mix_preset_info: Applies balanced vocal level, accompaniment level, and reverb settings.
cover.rms_mix_rate_info: Controls how closely vocal dynamics follow the source track; 0% disables matching.
cover.backing_mix_info: Blends original lead vocals for extra nuance; 0% uses pure AI vocals.
cover.karaoke_separation_info: Separates lead from backing vocals, converts only the lead, and exports accompaniment both with and without backing vocals.
cover.karaoke_merge_backing: Keep Original Backing Vocals in Mix
cover.karaoke_merge_backing_info: Uses accompaniment with backing vocals when on, or pure instrumental when off. Both stems are exported separately.
cover.batch_help: Queue multiple songs or vocal clips using the currently selected voice and settings. Preview each finished track below or download all outputs as a ZIP.
cover.batch_preview: Select a Track to Preview or Download Stems
cover.batch_archive_error: Could not create the ZIP archive; individual tracks remain available. {error}
cover.reuse_help: Changing pitch or voice on this page reuses separated stems; adjusting only mix levels, reverb, or lead blend remixes directly.
cover.progress_placeholder: Click Start Cover to view live progress, reused stages, and output paths here.
cover.batch_status_placeholder: Per-track queue status appears here once batch processing starts.
cover.vc_preprocess_mode_info: Uses Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050 to remove vocal reverb.
cover.source_constraint_mode_info: Aligns converted vocal timing and phrasing with the original track. Auto enables it after dereverberation.
cover.vc_preprocess_status_info: Displays the selected processing stages. Inspect local model files in Model Management.
cover.vc_pipeline_mode_info: Standard cover includes harmony separation and vocal cleanup; Official route uses classic UVR5. Vocals-only mode converts directly.
cover.input_mode_info: Full Song runs separation and mixing; Vocals Only converts dry vocals directly.

models.base_models_desc: HuBERT, RMVPE, and default separation models required for covers. Check local files or download any missing assets below.
models.model_status_placeholder: Click Check Model Status to inspect local base and separation models.
models.voice_models_desc: Place custom .pth files under assets/weights/, then refresh the list.
models.mature_deecho_models_desc: Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050 is used by default. Classic UVR / ONNX DeEcho models can be downloaded optionally below.
models.status_scope: Local model and component status summary.
models.workflow_models: Vocals: Leap XE 90 bands · Instrumental: Leap Instrumental 62 bands · Lead & Backing: MVSep 9205 avg_wave · Dereverb: Stereo BS-RoFormer 22.5050.

settings.device_managed_by_startup: Compute device is fixed by the startup environment. In Docker, switch the Compose file or image and recreate the container; locally, update the environment variable and restart.
settings.settings_saved_restart: Settings saved. Restart the app for changes to take effect.
settings.about_body:
**RVC AI Cover Studio**

- Compatible with RVC v1 / v2 voice models and exact FAISS retrieval
- Powered by Leap XE / Leap Instrumental, MVSep 9205, and Stereo BS-RoFormer dereverb
- Built-in synchronized multitrack preview with high-precision WAV stem export

[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/mason369/AI-RVC) · [Upstream RVC](https://github.com/RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI)
settings.model_sources:
### Character Model Repositories

Built-in voices come from the Hugging Face repositories below. You can also import `.pth` / `.index` / `.zip` via "Song Cover → Upload Custom Model", or place files under `assets/weights/characters/<character_name>/`:

**Love Live! Series**
- [trioskosmos/rvc_models](https://huggingface.co/trioskosmos/rvc_models) — μ's / Aqours / Nijigasaki / Liella! characters
- [Icchan/LoveLive](https://huggingface.co/Icchan/LoveLive) — Chika, Riko, Eli, You
- [0xMifune/LoveLive](https://huggingface.co/0xMifune/LoveLive) — Nijigasaki / Liella! / Hasunosora
- [Swordsmagus/Love-Live-RVC](https://huggingface.co/Swordsmagus/Love-Live-RVC) — Hanamaru, Setsuna, Kotori, A-RISE, and more
- [Zurakichi/RVC](https://huggingface.co/Zurakichi/RVC) — Nico, Kanata, Setsuna, Hanamaru
- [Phos252/RVCmodels](https://huggingface.co/Phos252/RVCmodels) — Kanon Shibuya
- [ChocoKat/Mari_Ohara](https://huggingface.co/ChocoKat/Mari_Ohara) — Mari Ohara
- [HarunaKasuga/YoshikoTsushima](https://huggingface.co/HarunaKasuga/YoshikoTsushima) — Yoshiko Tsushima
- [thebuddyadrian/RVC_Models](https://huggingface.co/thebuddyadrian/RVC_Models) — Kazuno sisters

**Genshin / Honkai / Zenless Zone Zero (HoYoverse)**
- [makiligon/RVC-Models](https://huggingface.co/makiligon/RVC-Models) — Furina, Ayaka, Focalors
- [kohaku12/RVC-MODELS](https://huggingface.co/kohaku12/RVC-MODELS) — Nahida, Herta, Firefly, Tingyun, Hoshimi Miyabi, and more
- [jarari/RVC-v2](https://huggingface.co/jarari/RVC-v2) — Furina (Korean), Silver Wolf (Korean)
- [mrmocciai/genshin-impact](https://huggingface.co/mrmocciai/genshin-impact) — Genshin voice models (`.pth` / `.index`)

**VOCALOID**
- [javinfamous/infamous_miku_v2](https://huggingface.co/javinfamous/infamous_miku_v2) — Hatsune Miku (1000 epochs)

**Hololive / VTuber**
- [megaaziib/my-rvc-models-collection](https://huggingface.co/megaaziib/my-rvc-models-collection) — Pekora, Sakura Miko, Subaru, Kobo, Kaela, and more
- [Kit-Lemonfoot/kitlemonfoot_rvc_models](https://huggingface.co/Kit-Lemonfoot/kitlemonfoot_rvc_models) — Hololive / Holostars / NIJISANJI characters

**THE IDOLM@STER / Uma Musume**
- [trioskosmos/rvc_models](https://huggingface.co/trioskosmos/rvc_models) — Ranko Kanzaki, Riamu Yumemi
- [makiligon/RVC-Models](https://huggingface.co/makiligon/RVC-Models) — Takane Shijou, Rice Shower

**Project SEKAI**
- [kohaku12/RVC-MODELS](https://huggingface.co/kohaku12/RVC-MODELS) — Nene Kusanagi

> After manual download, place `.pth` and `.index` files in `assets/weights/characters/<character_name>/`, then refresh the voice list.
